inputs.label: Issuer cell
inputs.body: Cell{ type: ISSUER (hash[0..20] = issuer_id), data: { class_count: a } }

outputs.label: Issuer cell
outputs.body: Cell{ type: ISSUER, data: { class_count: {{b > a}} } }

outputs.label: Class cell × (b − a)

cons.zh: 输入恰有 1 个这样的 issuer
不可变；>0 时 issued ≤ total

cond.zh: 输入中 type hash[0..20] = issuer_id 的 cell 恰 1 个；其 class_count 增加
cond.en: exactly 1 input whose type hash[0..20] = issuer_id; its class_count increases

cond.zh: 同 issuer 的 class 输出数 = 增量，id 依次为 [a..b)
cond.en: class outputs of this issuer = the increase, ids [a..b) in order

title.zh: 更新 class（如铸造 NFT 时）

inputs.label: Class cell
inputs.body: Cell{ type: CLASS, data: { issued: i, … } }

outputs.label: Class cell
outputs.body: Cell{ type: CLASS, data: { issued: {{≥ i}}, total/configure/name/description same } }

cond.zh: 同 issuer 的 class cell 输入数 = 输出数
cond.en: class cells of this issuer: inputs = outputs
issued never decreases; total, configure, name, description unchanged

notes.zh: 版本：wiki Lina-Mainnet-deployment 写明部署提交 b5af002，Aggron-Testnet-deployment 写明 d0a844d；两者合约代码只差 helper.rs 中 CLASS_TYPE_CODE_HASH 常量（主网 0xd51e…3d9a / 测试网 0x095b…e3fc）。之后的提交只调整目录结构与 capsule 版本。未做可复现构建。
notes.en: Version: the wiki Lina-Mainnet-deployment page names deployment commit b5af002 and Aggron-Testnet-deployment names d0a844d; the contract code differs only in helper.rs CLASS_TYPE_CODE_HASH (mainnet 0xd51e…3d9a / testnet 0x095b…e3fc). Later commits only restructure directories and bump capsule. No reproducible build was attempted.

notes.zh: 动作判断按“同一 issuer 的所有 class”计数（code_hash、hash_type 相同，args 24 字节且前 20 字节相同），不是只看本 class；但只校验本 group 第一个输入 / 输出的 data。
notes.en: The action is decided by counting all classes of the same issuer (same code_hash and hash_type, 24-byte args with the same first 20 bytes), not just this class; only this group's first input / output data is validated.

notes.zh: 规则 40（helper.rs）：找到第一个带此 type 的输入，取它的 lock，再找第一个使用该 lock 的输入；该位置的 WitnessArgs.lock 必须存在（witness 缺失或解析失败也算缺失），用于禁止 ACP 这类不签名的 lock 更新 / 销毁。
notes.en: Rule 40 (helper.rs): take the first input with this type, take its lock, find the first input with that lock; the WitnessArgs.lock at that index must be present (a missing or unparsable witness counts as absent). It blocks signature-less locks such as ACP from updating / destroying.
